best_idea: Run the whole server as one fixed-step loop (intake, then NPC and fight steps, then send) that resets its schedule on a whole-tick overrun instead of bursting, and refresh each nearby object on its own cadence, with the fight target and attackers at 250 ms.
decision_why: Keep the fixed-step deadline loop, drop-on-overrun rule, intake-then-fight-then-send order and per-object cadence; fix the busy-spin wait with a timer, count dropped ticks and send-buffer drops, and make cadence per-encounter data; reject guided multi-thread chunking and the 65,536-bucket wheel for a single-threaded Node server.
acceptance: A server test with a fake clock runs 100 iterations where one tick overruns by 2.5 tick lengths and asserts droppedTicks is 1, the next delay is one tick, and game time advanced by exactly 100 ticks; a player sees a target's HP change within 250 ms and does not receive NPC refreshes more often than the NPC cadence.
